title: Draft: feat(agent): add glab agent command via binarymgr (linux)
description:
## What this does

Adds a top-level `glab agent` command that downloads and runs the
`agent-client` binary (from the endpoint-agent-platform project) through
glab's existing `binarymgr` framework, forwarding all arguments to it.

It mirrors the existing `glab orbit` and `glab duo cli` binarymgr consumers:
glab downloads, checksum-verifies, atomically installs, schedules update
checks, and runs the managed binary. The glab-owned `--install`, `--update`,
and `--yes` flags and the `update` subcommand are handled by glab; every other
argument passes through verbatim.

**Linux only** for now.

## How it works

- **Source:** the **public** project `security-products/endpoint-agent-platform`
  (project `87908878`), generic package `agent-client`, assets
  `agent-client-linux-amd64` / `agent-client-linux-arm64` (raw static ELF, no
  extraction). Download is anonymous — no token needed.
- **Linux-only gating:** `Spec.SupportedOS = ["linux"]`; `NormalizeArch`
  returns `ErrUnsupportedPlatform` on any non-linux GOOS.
- **`agent` subcommand prefix:** the downloaded binary's feature tree lives
  under `agent-client agent ...` (install, hook, version, uninstall, verify,
  evaluate, auth). The executor prepends the literal `agent` arg, so
  `glab agent install` runs `agent-client agent install`.
- **No credential injection:** glab does not inject auth env into the binary.
  The client authenticates itself via `glab agent auth login` (it ships its
  own `auth` subcommand), matching `glab duo cli`.
- **No new module dependency:** glab does not import the endpoint-agent-platform
  Go module — it only downloads the binary at runtime.

## Changes

| Area | Change |
|------|--------|
| `internal/binarymgr/binaries/agent.go` | New `AgentCLI()` Spec (linux-only, raw binary) |
| `internal/binarymgr/passthrough.go` | **New shared helper** — `Flags`, `SplitFlags`, `HelpOnly`, `NewRunner` |
| `internal/commands/orbit/orbit.go` | Rewired to the shared helper (dropped its duplicated copy, ~68 lines) |
| `internal/commands/agent/` | New command: `agent.go`, unix/windows executors, `update` subcommand |
| `internal/config/schema.go` | New `agent_cli_*` config keys (mirror `orbit_cli_*`) |
| `internal/commands/root.go` | Register `glab agent` |
| `docs/source/**` | Regenerated via `make gen-docs` |

The pass-through flag-splitting logic was **extracted into
`internal/binarymgr/passthrough.go`** and is now shared by both `agent` and
`orbit` instead of being copied per command (addresses the review's
code-duplication finding; orbit keeps its own executor/credential wiring).

## Tests

- Spec: `AssetName`, `NormalizeArch` (linux amd64/arm64 + unsupported-platform
  errors), `InstalledName`.
- Command: flag splitting, `agent`-prefix prepend, `validate()`
  mutual-exclusion errors, `runHelp()` installed-vs-missing branches.
- `go build ./...`, `go test`, `go vet`, and the repo comment-overlap gate all
  pass. orbit tests still pass after the refactor.

## Review notes

- The downloaded binary is **not signed yet** (Linux is unaffected by signing;
  signing is tracked separately). This command is gated to Linux for now.
- Supersedes the earlier direct-import approach in !4113 (which linked the
  endpoint-agent-platform module into glab); this binarymgr approach keeps the
  private module out of glab entirely.

Related: gitlab-org/gitlab#627904. The public generic package it downloads is
published by endpoint-agent-platform!29 (merged).
